This '''serum''' was a product of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] meant to reverse aging. It was created from [[Droch/Legends|drochs]] from [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] on orders from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]], but fell in the hands of [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] trio [[Grees]], [[Sligh]], and [[Emala]], who handed it over to Imperial Remnant [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] after he threaten to arrest them for stealing imperial property.
